name: Telepathy - sender (Persinger 2003 style)
summary: Six 5-min circumcerebral configurations for the SENDER, who looks at the target while the receiver (unstimulated, another room) writes impressions. Timings follow the descriptions of Persinger, Koren & Tsang 2003 (20 ms and 100 ms steps, 20 ms step lengthened by 2 ms); the exact fields are unpublished, so this is an approximation.
source: Persinger, Koren & Tsang 2003, Percept Mot Skills 97:877 (PMID 14738355) ; https://www.god-helmet.com/wp/shiva/shiva_evidence.htm
